subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Realistic User Scenarios
description: A micro-lesson that makes Realistic User Scenarios usable.

hook.text: A load test hammers the homepage 10,000 times. In reality, only 5% of users ever visit the homepage.

buildup.text: Unrealistic test scenarios give misleading results because they don't match actual usage patterns.

discovery.text: Good performance tests model real traffic: browsing, searching, adding to cart, and checking out.

twist.text: Production analytics reveal the actual mix. Testing the wrong mix tests a system that doesn't exist.

climax.text: Redesigning tests to match real traffic patterns reveals a checkout bottleneck nobody had noticed.

punchline.text: Test what users actually do. Not what you imagine they do.

quiz.question: Why should load tests match real traffic patterns?
options: Real patterns are easier to code
